beats.say: You tap pay, the network times out, so your app retries. Did the customer just get charged twice?

beats.text: Any request might arrive more than once.
beats.say: Retries happen everywhere, in clients, load balancers, and message queues. So any request might arrive more than once.

beats.text: Idempotent: many times = same effect as once.
beats.say: An operation is idempotent if doing it many times has the same effect as doing it once. Setting a status is safe. Adding money is not.

beats.text: Attach a unique idempotency key to each request.
beats.say: The fix: the client attaches a unique idempotency key to every request.

beats.text: Same key = saved response. Charged exactly once.
beats.say: The server remembers the keys it has seen. The first request is processed. A retry with the same key just gets the saved response, so the customer is charged exactly once.
